label: KTB route frame entails the B schema of the route's NECESSARY_2 box
meaning: Strength order registration: if the route's modal frame is reflexive and symmetric (KTB), the B schema (convergence formula 0 0 1 1: an atom that holds at a world is possible at every world accessible from it) of the route's box is valid on it. Applies the existing modal-library theorem TruthCore.Modal.axiomB_valid to the frame's symmetry. Establishes neither premise.
